title: Hearty Roasted Saudi Arabian Polish Sausage Skewers
description: A flavorful and crunchy dish featuring Polish sausage, inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine, with a unique nigiri-shaping technique, perfect for adventurous eaters, and friendly to those with egg allergies.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced Polish sausage, onion, and bell pepper to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated ingredients onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the sausage is browned and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
